#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class TaskC {
public:
    void solve(int w, int m) {
        int n = 0;
        int a[100] = {0}; // larger than 50 to avoid overflow
        do {
            a[++n] = m % w;
            m /= w;
        } while (m > 0);

        bool ok = true;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n;) {
            if (a[i] > 1) {
                a[i] += 1;
                if (a[i] == w) {
                    while (i <= n && a[i] >= w) {
                        a[i] = 0;
                        a[++i] += 1;
                    }
                } else {
                    ++i;
                }
                if (a[i - 1] > 1) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                ++i;
            }
        }
        if (ok) cout << "YES" << endl;
        else cout << "NO" << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    TaskC solver;
    solver.solve(w, m);
    return 0;
}
